## CELEBRATE A DREAMY BEACHSIDE WEDDING IN VIBRANT PHUKET

Uncover Phuket, Thailand — a top international wedding
destination, where affordable luxury, Indian food options, and
beach-hilltop venues craft a stunning romantic retreat. Ideal for
couples seeking the best Phuket destination wedding, this island
blends coastal charm with modern flair.


From top-rated resorts like JW Marriott to luxury escapes at The
Slate and Sri Panwa, Phuket delivers budget-friendly elegance.
Picture a beachside ceremony, a hilltop vow exchange, or a grand
resort reception — every moment shines with love and allure.


At Humsafar Weddings, we design your ideal Phuket wedding with
bespoke planning, flawless execution, and heartfelt passion —
delivering the best Thailand destination wedding experience.


Because in Phuket, your wedding isn’t just a day — it’s a
luxurious love story kissed by sea and sun.


### WHY CHOOSE UDAIPUR FOR YOUR DESTINATION WEDDING?

- **Top wedding venues**: JW Marriott, The Slate, Sri Panwa

- Perfect blend of affordable luxury and beach wedding charm

- Ideal for beach vows, hilltop ceremonies, or grand receptions

- Unique Phuket highlights: Indian cuisine, sunset views, tropical
vibes

- **Best Time**: November to March
- **Visa Info**: Visa on Arrival (15 days) or eVisa (30 days)


![Udaipur Lake View](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/world/Phuket/Portrait.png)

## Top Destination Wedding Venues PHUKET, THAILAND

### _JW MARRIOTT PHUKET RESORT & SPA (MAI KHAO)_

- **Rooms:** 262
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor up to 350 guests; Outdoor
lawns up to 660 guests

- **Distance from Airport (Phuket International Airport):**
15 km (~15 minutes)

- **Distance from Railway Station:** Not applicable (No
railway system in Phuket)


![JW Marriot](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/world/Phuket/JW-Marriot.jpg)

![Slate](https://humsafar-wedding.netlify.app/images/world/Phuket/Slate.jpg)

### _THE SLATE, PHUKET (NAI YANG BEACH)_

- **Rooms:** 185 rooms, suites & villas
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor up to 200 guests; Outdoor
lawns up to 300 guests

- **Distance from Airport (Phuket International Airport):**
3.2 km (~10 minutes)

- **Distance from Railway Station:** Not applicable (No
railway system in Phuket)


### _SRI PANWA, PHUKET (CAPE PANWA)_

- **Rooms:** 52 luxury pool villas & suites
- **Banquets & Lawns:** Indoor up to 80 guests; Outdoor
lawns up to 200 guests

- **Distance from Airport (Phuket International Airport):**
40 km (~45–50 minutes)

- **Distance from Railway Station:** Not applicable (No
railway system in Phuket)
